notes: Part of the PLAN 3.1 population sample: 15 skills drawn by even stride from the path-sorted library, one task each, to estimate how much of the library adds nothing measurable over a bare model. One task cannot characterise a skill — this measures the population, not this skill.

tasks.prompt: In a Jetpack Compose screen I need the camera permission before opening a capture screen. Handle the first request, the rationale case, and permanent denial. Kotlin.

expect.label: shows a rationale when the system asks for one
routes permanent denial to app settings rather than re-prompting
